name: Camera controller
responsibility: Owns the pane's camera controls, immediate pinches, eased wheel and key moves, and when the camera rests
description: useBoardCamera creates one external camera store, delegates arithmetic to camera.ts and easing to useCameraMotion, and exposes camera reads and subscriptions to the diagram and its surface. A hand's move rests after cameraRest and after its ease ends. A zoom drops its compositor layer first, then releases the far reading on the next frame; a pan rests immediately.

outgoing.label: glide there, a frame at a time
ease wheel and key moves
outgoing.description: useBoardCamera creates useCameraMotion(stage, reducedMotion); wheel and key controls call its zoomAt and ease, while pinches write immediately.

outgoing.label: pan, pinch and zoom arithmetic
outgoing.description: use-board-camera.ts panBy calls panCamera, pinch calls pinchCamera and ctrl-wheel calls zoomCameraAbout.

outgoing.label: create, write, settle, hold and subscribe
outgoing.description: useBoardCamera creates createCameraStore; its controls call write, comeToRest calls settle and hold, and useCameraView/useCameraWith expose subscriptions.

outgoing.label: rest timer, then one frame after zoom
outgoing.description: restLater calls frameClock().after(cameraRest); comeToRest calls requestFrame to release the held rest after the layer drops.
